notes.title: Free "Modding Tool" Update - Out Now!
notes.content:
Ahoy cursed pirates!

We know, we said the Shadow Gambit DLCs are going to be our last update. But we actually have one more thing to share with you.  

Since [i]Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun[/i], many of you have been requesting some sort of modding level editor for our games. We took a first step in that direction with the implementation of the Level Editing Cheats for Desperados 3.

[b]Today, we're thrilled to release the "Modding Tool" for [i][url=mod.io/g/shadow-gambit] Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew [/url][/i]as a free update![/b]

We're adding this feature to the main game with the latest patch update, which is live now.

This our very final parting gift to you!

[previewyoutube=5-SqMI4jDvQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*]Read all the details about the "Modding Tool" in our blog post: [url=https://www.shadowgambit.com/modding-tool]https://www.shadowgambit.com/modding-tool[/url]
[*] [b]Join the modding adventures in our dedicated and official Shadow Gambit modding space on Mod.io: [url=https://mod.io/g/shadow-gambit]https://mod.io/g/shadow-gambit[/url]
[*]Also, don't forget to join our Discord server, where you can discuss your mods with fellow modders: [url=https://discord.gg/mimimi]https://discord.gg/mimimi[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix #3 Patch Update: Now Live!
notes.content:
Avast ye, cursed pirates! 

We've just released a Hotfix patch update.

It addresses the most crucial bugs that you have reported since the launch of the two DLCs [i]Shadow Gambit: Yuki's Wish[/i] and [i]Shadow Gambit: Zagan's Ritual[/i].

Here are the most important changes that we've made:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug in the character mission "Gaelle's Letter (Ch.2)" preventing the player from leaving the warehouse.
[*] Unfortunately the save games for this mission will be deprecated and players will need to restart it. In other missions this should not be the case.
[*] Fixed crashes and issues when using Yuki’s Tanuki Kuma in some edge cases.
[*] Fixed the “Give Them No Quarter” badge that was not properly working before.
[*] Removed “The Tome” hard setup double enemies.
[*] Implemented several small fixes.
[/list]
Yours,
The Mimimis

notes.title: Version 1.2: DLC & Free Content Update
notes.content:
[h1]Most Imporatent Changes:[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Toya should no longer get stuck on executing Shadow Step if stepping into a bush with hidden NPCs
[*] Pinkus now has much more to say while perusing the minds of guards and executing their specific skills
[*] Pinkus no longer continues to carry heavy objects when perusing the mind of a guard that currently does so
[*] Pinkus is now more reliable in executing planned commands after exiting a trapdoor
[*] Afia's Time Freeze now affects a Prognosticar that is already locked in combat with another character
[*] Virgilio no longer duplicates the weapons he is using
[*] Fixed inconsistent behavior of certain skills when character takes damage
[*] Guards spawned during an alarm can now hear distractions again
[*] Fixed rare case of additional weapon asset being spawned during the death animation of a guard
[/list]
[h2]Missions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed lighting not being loaded properly in certain cases
[*] Minor adjustment to failure conditions of certain badges
[*] Fixed a few mission scripting errors
[*] Fixes and improvements to navigation in several locations
[*] Fixed rare case of softlocking mission objectives when saving during a dialog
[*] Adjusted Viewcone draw height on Angler's Grave
[*] Fixed replay screen showing incorrect kill/ko numbers after certain skill usage
[*] Fixed rare cases of guards not appearing in the replay screen
[*] Fixed a droppable boulder on Iron Bay blocking a larger area than it should
[/list]
[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved cloth simulation for certain cases
[*] Fixed certain cases in which incorrect audio would play during location introduction videos
[*] Improved video file loading to reduce frame stutters on starting the video
[*] Added some missing german voice over files
[*] Several localization tweaks and fixes
[*] Several UI tweaks and fixes
[*] Added some more keybind options and fixed some keybinds not working as expected
[/list]

The update alsao includes the new "Treasure Hunt" update and more. For details see the blog post: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1545560/view/3897365840783637717

notes.title: Shadow Gambit: New DLCs & Free Update – NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Ahoy, cursed pirates! Prepare for the final chapter as we unfurl the sails of the Red Marley in [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545560/Shadow_Gambit_The_Cursed_Crew/]Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew[/url][/i] one more time.

Join us on this epic farewell with the two extraordinary DLCs [i]Shadow Gambit: Yuki's Wish[/i] and [i]Shadow Gambit: Zagan's Ritual[/i]. Now available in our own [url=https://shadowgambit.com/store]Official Shadow Gambit Key Store[/url] and here on Steam!

Check out the DLC trailer here: 
[previewyoutube=LlJ6gVAkZNs;full][/previewyoutube]
But the adventure doesn't end there. Dive into new challenges with the free "Treasure Hunt" update for the main game, seize the new Complete Edition, and bask in a weekend delight with a 20% discount.

So, assemble your cursed crew –  and let the grand finale begin!

[h1]Shadow Gambit DLCs – OUT NOW![/h1]
Set the Red Marley's sails for the two new DLC expansions Shadow Gambit: Yuki's Wish and Shadow Gambit: Zagan's Ritual. They are available NOW on PC and consoles!

Each DLC features several hours of fresh content including a [b]brand-new character, an uncharted magical island and an epic story campaign across six new missions[/b] to experience.

You can get them both in our [url=https://shadowgambit.com/store]Official Shadow Gambit Key Store[/url] if you want to support us directly.

[h2]Shadow Gambit: Yuki's Wish[/h2]
First up is [i]Shadow Gambit: Yuki's Wish[/i]. No, we are casting no illusion spell on you, this is really happening:  Yuki and Kuma from [i]Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun[/i] make a triumphant return! Cursed by the Lost Caribbean waters, they bring all-new supernatural abilities to the Red Marley's crew. 

Embark to the fabled Japanese-themed island "Dragon's Dream", where an ancient dragon awaits, promising to grant wishes to the brave. The question echoes in the Caribbean air – will you solve the dragon's riddles and fulfill Yuki's wish? Join Yuki and Kuma on this extraordinary quest, unraveling a new story across six mesmerizing missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43536377/17c96f1da18ed4b49a6a91dfa0d61c67b32c367c.png[/img]

[h2]Shadow Gambit: Zagan's Ritual[/h2]
Meanwhile, [i]Shadow Gambit: Zagan's Ritual[/i] invites your cursed crew on an eerie island with a mysterious Gothic-style castle. Inhabited by the enigmatic scientist "Zagan the Apostate", you are invited to help him to perform a dark ritual. Uncover the secrets of the Inquisition's holy flame through six enthralling missions, wielding Zagan's potent yet unstable powers against your foes. Are you ready to explore the corrupted nature of this closely-guarded Inquisition enigma?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43536377/00c5e7a8abcdd9e7f692500fbe4baa9df2452130.png[/img]

[h2]Where to buy?[/h2]

Both DLCs are now available for 14.99 $/€ in our own [url=https://shadowgambit.com/store]Official Shadow Gambit Key Store[/url] or here on Sream!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2304810

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576620

Good to know: Both DLCs integrate seamlessly into the main game. Notably, the new DLC characters will also be at the your disposal for almost any main game mission.

[h1]Free Content Update: Treasure Hunts[/h1]
In addition to the grand DLC adventures, we have another parting gift for all players in the form of the FREE "Treasure Hunts" content update on PC and consoles. 

Unleash your inner explorer as the update invites you on unique "Treasure Hunt" quests for legendary pirate treasures and artifacts. This new endgame content is seamlessly integrated into the main game through a patch on December 6.

Set against the backdrop of the Lost Caribbean, the "Treasure Hunts" offer a unique free-roam experience, allowing players to set foot on the islands without the constraints of specific story missions. 

All "Treasure Hunts" are a part of this free roam experience in the respective locations and offer skill-testing challenges across 14 distinct "Treasure Hunt" missions. Each of them features different gameplay twists and engaging objectives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43536377/eff4a082627ec285b899ebb0867d3e2ea82f109a.png[/img]
For example, picture yourself following remnants on the enigmatic island of Calamity Reef, pointing you towards hidden treasures or wield a magical pistol to eliminate a set number of guards, unveiling a covered treasure chest. A dedicated codex page tracks your completion progress, adding a layer of accomplishment to your treasure-seeking endeavors. 

The "Treasure Hunts" update gives you a new engaging endgame experience, beckoning you to explore more of the mysteries of the Lost Caribbean.

[h1]Complete Edition: All-in-One Pirate Booty Package[/h1]
For those who are still seeking to play the main game or want to upgrade their experience, we have something special: the Complete Edition!

Dive into the Main Game, DLCs, Original Soundtrack, and the Artbook & Strategy Guide, all bundled at a special discounted price – with the new Complete Edition bundle. 

The Complete Edition is available now for 69,99 $/€ in our own [url=https://shadowgambit.com/store]Official Shadow Gambit Key Store[/url] as well as here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35969/]Steam[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43536377/8b360c7cdbb9b48ce5e6040f501d20f051f72bcc.png[/img]

[h2]-20% Discount[/h2]
Moreover, to celebrate this grand finale, we're applying a 20% discount to the [i]Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew[/i] main game, the Original Soundtrack and the Artbook & Strategy Guide over the weekend until December 14.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43536377/01333075d6ae06eb3387108b199231c4a45371d8.png[/img]
Head over to our [url=https://shadowgambit.com/store]Official Shadow Gambit Key Store[/url] – or here on Steam – to seize this limited-time offer and join the Red Marley's cursed crew on their fantastic adventure into the heart of the Lost Caribbean.


Fair winds, brave pirates, and thank you for an unforgettable journey!

Yours,
The Mimimis

notes.title: Big patch update for Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew is now live!
notes.content:
Ahoy mateys,

We trust you've been enjoying your adventures in Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew, exploring the Lost Caribbean with the Red Marley and your cursed crew members!

Following the rollout of a [url=https://www.shadowgambit.com/shadow-gambit-hotfix/]hotfix update[/url] for PC, which addressed some first crucial issues, we are now ready to release a bigger patch update.

It features a number of bug fixes and changes to improve your (un-)life as cursed pirates. For example, we're adding the camera controls from [i]Desperados III[/i] and [i]Shadow Tactics[/i].

The patch update is is out now on PC – and coming to consoles very soon!

Read the full patch notes with the most important fixes and changes here: 

[h2]Patch Notes [/h2]

[h3]Most Important Fixes[/h3]

[b]Controls[/b]

Classic controller camera controls

We brought back the camera controls from Desperados III and Shadow Tactics. You can switch under "Options" > "Gameplay" > "Camera Follow Mode" and change it to Standard.

In this mode you can pan the camera with the right stick. When you hold down RT you can zoom and rotate with the right stick. You can pin the camera to the current selected player by tapping RT. This was D-pad down in [i]Desperados III [/i]and [i]Shadow Tactics.[/i]

Classic RTS control scheme

Default button layout has been adjusted so "Execute Shadow Mode" keys no longer conflict with other keys.

Fixed cases of mouse clicks not being handled properly in this control scheme.
[list]
[*] Doors/Ladders now use the correct movement mouse button
[*] Viewcone can be activated correctly in all cases
[/list]
[b]Logbook[/b]
[list]
[*] Logbook hotkey (default bound to F2) is now rebindable.
[*] Completion percentage calculations have been adjusted and should now properly end up at 100%
[/list]
[b]Badges[/b]
[list]
[*] Cry Some More: Killing "Basito el Amanuensis" on Gran Alcazar now correctly counts toward this badge
[*] Bigger On The Inside: Entering the Marley's Hold now correctly triggers this badge. Any story mission, tutorial room or crew tale will work
[*] Deadly Ascent: Adjusted evaluation algorithm and added a badge failed notification. Badge is granted on mission completion if successful.
[*] NOTE: Due to technical limitations, this badge can only be completed in the mission "Prepare For Trouble"
[/list]
[b]Golden Skeletons[/b]
[list]
[*] Golden Skeleton in Gaëlle's Training Deck is now accessible to be killed
[/list]
[h3]Small fixes and improvements[/h3]
[b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed model of planning mode ghost for various NPCs while Pinkus is perusing their mind
[*] Fixed a few incorrectly rendered effects
[*] Fixed effect flickering on certain hardware
[*] Several small tweaks to cutscenes
[*] Added small visual effect for Estelle on returning to the Marley after completing a mission
[*] Fixed incorrectly placed cutscene camera in certain cases
[*] Fixed Afia being crouched in an important story cutscene if she is crouched when cutscene starts
[*] Fixed Ignacia already carrying a certain object while attempting to pick it up during the cutscene
[*] Fixed camera shake not properly ending in certain cases when quickly skipping a cutscene
[*] Adjusted positions of characters in a few cutscenes
[*] Fixed dynamic bend of foliage objects in reaction to player character movement
[*] Improved cloth behavior for player characters in certain cases
[*] Added portrait animation for a certain important story character
[*] Fixed mirror lights not turning on properly in certain cases during Act 3
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved handling of Pinkus' context actions for Kill/Carry/Tie Up actions
[*] Fixed several edge case interactions with NPCs that Pinkus used "Mind Peruse" on
[*] It should no longer be possible to fire non-swimmer characters into the water with Gaëlle's "Fire Kanol" skill
[*] Fixed missing jump prompts from a small boat to the beach in Calamity Reef
[*] Improved navigation around the beaches of New Krucbury and the Isle of Penance
[*] Fixed issues with planning actions while a character is using doors
[*] Fixed saving being blocked after restarting a mission during a cutscene

[b][u]Beware: Spoilers![/u][/b] 
[*] Fixed several skill interactions with Virgilio
[*] The bolt of mimicked Teresa's "Iron Judgment" no longer gets lost after switching off of her
[*] Mimicked Afia now has the same context action evaluation on her skill as when used by the original Afia
[*] Gaëlle's "Fire Kanol" skill can now no longer be used while inside of another Kanol. This applies to both the first or the second Kanol being mimicked at the time.
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved volume handling of NPC dialog in the intro mission on Angler's Grave
[*] Improved audio handling in a certain climactic cutscene
[*] Enabled Voice Over language change option during missions
[*] Fixed sound effect when firing the cannons on the Marley being delaye
[*] Added missing german voice overs for the Lighthouse Keeper on Calamity Reef
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed red X incorrectly being shown on interactable objects in certain circumstances
[*] Fixed missing or overlapping input icons in certain cases
[*] Improved UI navigation in mission selection screens with controller
[*] Disabled character slot re-ordering on the Marley
[*] Fixed key icons still being shown on the map on an NPC after they have been taken by the player
[*] Fixed Upgrades and Crew Tales objectives still being shown in the UI after already completing all of them
[*] Improved feedback when aiming trajectory is blocked
[*] Fixed several translation errors and typos across multiple languages
[*] Fixed incorrect portrait being shown when perusing the mind of a Magistratus
[*] Improved Dialogue Log automatic scrolling
[*] Improved visuals of icon on not yet unlocked badges
[*] Fixed the Newsfeed being able to overlap with the Memory menu in the Main Menu
[/list]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare case of main story getting stuck in a "Revive X characters" quest
[*] Fixed post effects not being properly set after loading a quicksave (e.g. Chromatic Abberation)
[*] Wait when closing the game while a savegame write is still in progress as to not lose progress
[*] Fixed memory capture issue in the Training Decks after progressing too far with unlocking a certain Easter Egg
[*] Added handling for detecting disconnecting controllers
[*] Added handling for Steam Deck screen lock becoming active
[*] Potentially fixed a game crash for old CPUs that could happen during loading screens
[*] Fixed cases of rogue savefiles being left on disk of already completed missions
[*] Fixed pathfinding issues when loading a in-progress mission after applying a patch
[*] Fixed several typos in the Credits
[*] Added Kowloon logo animation to the bootup sequence
[*] Adjusted hardware thresholds for automatic graphic settings detection (results in better default quality settings for more users – only applies on fresh game starts)
[/list]

[h2]Where to get support & report bugs[/h2]

Cursed pirates, if you and the Red Marley find yourselves in troubled waters on your treasure hunt across the Lost Caribbean, set sail for our support page: https://shadowgambit.com/support.

There you can report bugs and find answers or solutions to the most common questions and known issues.
Of course, you can also ask the community for help on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/mimimi]Discord[/url] server or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1545560/discussions]Steam forum[/url].

[h2]Join our crew[/h2]
☠️ Join our[url=https://discord.gg/mimimi] Discord [/url] if you want to chat about the game with us and our growing Mimimi community.

☠️ You can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/MimimiProd]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.youtube.com/@MimimiGamesYT]YouTube[/url] | [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mimimitwitch]Twitch[/url] | [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/mimimiprod]Facebook[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/mimimigames/]Instagram[/url] |[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@mimimigames] TikTok[/url] to stay up to date.

☠️ And we also have a [url=https://us8.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=0c53f747162bea2120626e936&id=8172471414]Newsletter[/url] if you’d like to receive updates directly from us to your email inbox.

notes.title: Hotfix Update: Now Live!
notes.content:
A Hotfix update is now live, addressing the most crucial bugs that have come to our attention since the launch.

For one, save game errors have been causing a ruckus, but fear not: We're providing some first fixes with this update to solve this and some other critical issues. Also, a bigger patch will follow soon!

Here are the most important changes that we made with this Hotfix update:

[h2]IMPORTANT CHANGES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed two different occurrences of "Something went wrong while capturing a memory" issues
[list]
[*] Using Pinkus von Presswald to overtake a Prognosticar and then using the "Rite of (attempted) Excision" skill
[*] Playing extended sessions (multiple hours) in the same mission. Primarily affected missions on the islands Iron Bay and Angler's Grave.
[/list]
[*] Fixed a progression issue related to character revives that could occur after a crash
[*] Fixed camera movement when using keyboard
[/list]

[h2]WHERE TO GET SUPPORT & REPORT BUGS[/h2]
Ay, cursed pirates, set sail for our support page if you and the Red Marley find yourselves in troubled waters on your treasure hunt across the Lost Caribbean: [url=https://shadowgambit.com/support]https://shadowgambit.com/support[/url]

There you can report bugs and find answers or solutions to the most common questions and known issues.

Of course, you can also ask the community for help on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/mimimi]Discord[/url] server or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1545560/discussions]Steam forum[/url].

For one, save game errors have been causing a ruckus, but fear not: We're providing some first fixes with this update to solve this and some other critical issues. A bigger patch will follow soon!

Here are the most important changes that we made with this Hotfix update, which is now live:

[h2]IMPORTANT CHANGES / PATCH NOTES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed two different occurrences of "Something went wrong while capturing a memory" issues
[list]
[*] Using Pinkus von Presswald to overtake a Prognosticar and then using the "Rite of (attempted) Excision" skill
[*] Playing extended sessions (multiple hours) in the same mission. Primarily affected missions on the islands Iron Bay and Angler's Grave.
[/list]
[*] Fixed a progression issue related to character revives that could occur after a crash
[*] Fixed camera movement when using keyboard
[/list]

[h2]WHERE TO GET SUPPORT & REPORT BUGS[/h2]

notes.title: Demo Feedback Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Ahoy cursed pirates![/b]

Over the past few weeks, we've been discussing your demo feedback within the team. 

We're happy to say that we've implemented the most common feedback points from you for the release of [i]Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew[/i]. All these improvements will be part of the final release version on August 17:

[h3]Low Intensity Mode for Saving and Loading Effects[/h3]
Some of you expressed concerns about the intensity of the special effects during capturing and unleashing memories. In the final game, you can enable the "Low Intensity Mode" in the gameplay options, reducing the brightness and flashy behavior of the default effect. We also refined the timing and pacing of the default effect.

[h3]CTRL+LMB for Interactions[/h3]
In the final game, both the new way of holding LMB and the traditional way of holding CTRL+LMB to interact with objects are supported at the same time.

[h3]Personalized Save Reminder Visuals[/h3]
We've implemented a new feature allowing you to choose between two distinct Save Reminder Visuals in the final game: The green ghost bell by the Red Marley or a more classic time reminder, reminiscent of Desperados 3. You'll have also the option to turn off the save reminder completely.

[h3]Enhanced Gamepad Camera[/h3]
We've improved the gamepad camera UI feedback and the locked camera state for the final game.

[h3]WASD Camera Controls[/h3]
We've fixed a bug, which was prevalent in the demo, preventing players to rebind all four camera directions. For example, you'll be able to rebind the camera directions to the WASD keys instead of the arrow keys if you prefer.

Thank you so much for your support and being an awesome crew! 💚 🏴‍☠️


[h2]JOIN OUR CREW[/h2]

☠️ Join our[url=https://discord.gg/mimimi] Discord [/url] if you want to chat about the game with us and our growing Mimimi community.

☠️ And we have a [url=http://signup.mimimi.games]Newsletter[/url] if you'd like to receive updates directly from us to your email inbox.

See you soon on the high seas, cursed pirates!

Best
Matthias, Elena & Adriano
Communications Team @ Mimimi Games

notes.title: 8 new gameplay features that you migh have missed so far
notes.content:
Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew is our next Stealth Strategy game coming for PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S in 2023. Even so the core gameplay our fans love so much stays the same, we made a lot of interesting changes and introduced new gameplay features to evolve the genre. 

In this video we want to introduce you to 8 new gameplay features in Shadow Gambit that work differently from Desperados 3 or Shadow Tactics.

[previewyoutube=TUWftglzO1Q;full][/previewyoutube]
If you are more of a reader you can find all the new gameplay features here as well:

[h2]NEW ENEMY TYPES[/h2]

In Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew you fight the Inquisition of the Burning Maiden – a religious army that despises everything related to cursed soul magic. Every Inquisition soldier has different tricks up their sleeve you have to counter – let’s name a few examples here:

[list]
[*] Acolyte: Standard guards as you know them from our previous games – but there a variants with a large alarm bell who can call for reinforcements
[*] Commissarius: Higher rank guards who can’t be distracted as easily as common Acolytes – similar to the Ponchos in Desperados 3
[*] Kindred: A pair of monks with a special mind connection – if one is killed, the other will be alarmed and revive their counterpart; they need to be taken out at the same time to avoid detection
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43536377/d9800228bed7c35613bacdc297e755e9449daabd.png[/img]
[i]You will encounter different types of Inquisition guards in Shadow Gambit. Some require specific actions to take them down like the pair of Kindred here.[/i]

But there are even more enemies we will introduce at a later date. You can also read more about the good guys here and learn about their personalities and abilities.

[h2]Sandbox Structure[/h2]

The open sandbox structure of  Shadow Gambit allows you to approach missions more freely. Besides some mandatory destinations you can select which island to visit next as well as which mission to tackle there. You will unlock more islands as the game progresses. 

Shadow Gambit offers a great variety of handcrafted islands with exotic beaches, lively towns, mysterious swamps and more waiting for you to explore them.

Multiple missions can take place on different parts of the same islands - during the day or at night. So you will revisit locations. Even so the mission objectives are different, the whole island will be accessible every time.

There is a greater variety of mission lengths than in our previous games as well. Some missions are short and only take 15 to 30 minutes of your time. This means you can easily finish them in one run. But you'll also encounter longer missions on larger islands - some of them are as big or even bigger than the mission maps of Desperados 3. Generally speaking, there will be more missions overall, but some of them are shorter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43536377/d5e914e107334a0873599c217d445f9e9079935c.png[/img]
[i]The open mission structure of Shadow Gambit allows for a lot of freedom. Players can decide which Island to sail to, which crewmembers to take with them and where on the island they want to start the mission.[/i]

[h2]Alarm Changes[/h2]

Raising the alarm will now only alert the guards in the area. But watch out for the Acolyte with a bell on their back we mentioned before. They can call for reinforcements, so make sure to stop them when they try to activate their bell or avoid them altogether.

[h2]Building Your Own Crew[/h2]

In Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew you are way more flexible when it comes to choosing your characters. You will able to select and combine all characters freely prior to missions - but you have to unlock them first. Even so they are eight playable characters in total, you start with the navigator Afia and get to choose between two predefined characters to join her. After that it's up to you who of the cursed pirate crew you revive next.

To do so, you need a black pearl and soul energy. Both can be collected as a reward for completing certain missions. The standard number of characters you can take on mission will be three, but there are certain story related missions that will allow you to bring more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43536377/2b52686a249e700d3cadc17f3b4ebcd37fe56ac0.png[/img]
[i]Players can decide which characters they want to bring on mission. Every character has unique personality as well as magical abilities that can be combined to overcome challenges.[/i]

You can also interact with the characters of our game while chilling on the Hub - Your ghost ship the Red Marley. You can chat with the crew or help them with little tasks while completing Hub quests. This way you learn more about their past and motivations - as well as during dedicated character missions.

If you want to learn more about how we developed a crew of different characters with unique personalities and skills, check out our Dev Diary about the character design of Shadow Gambit.

[h2]Death Is Not The End[/h2]

Cursed pirates are harder to kill than the cowboys and cowgirls from Desperados 3. Killed crewmembers can be revived - that means death doesn't have to result in reloading or game over. But revive is only possible during a certain time frame that gets shorter each time if a character dies a lot during one mission. 

If the timer runs out, the character's body has to be returned to the Marley to be revived there by her power and remains dead till the end of the mission. If all characters die or if an essential character dies during a mission, it's game over.

[h2]Time Manipulation[/h2]

Quicksave and -load are now a part of the story and linked to the time manipulation power of the Red Marley. Characters react to them and they play an important part in the story as well - but no spoilers here, of course!

[h2]Difficulty
[/h2]

The standard difficulty is more accessible than in Desperados 3 due to the higher amount of flexibility. But don't worry, there will be different difficulty settings and gameplay strategies to make the game more challenging for Stealth Strategy veterans.

[h2]Challenges and Badges[/h2]

The re-playability of Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew is very high because you can approach each mission again with different character combinations and entry or exit points. 

Badges and challenges also return, but they are different from Desperados 3. This time, you can fulfill badges during your first playthrough, but you can only restart missions after finishing the game. Once the story is completed, you are presented with all the badges or challenges and can revisit missions to tackle them.

Of course there are even more new gameplay features and changes we want to share with you in the future. If you want to stay up to date make sure to follow our communication channels:

[h2]Join Our Crew[/h2]

What change or new feature are you more excited about? 

☠️ Join our[url=https://discord.gg/mimimi] Discord [/url] if you want to chat about the game with us and our growing Mimimi community.

☠️ You can also follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/MimimiProd]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC1pT3v_j7vHP38zDDajDsvQ]YouTube[/url] | [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mimimitwitch]Twitch[/url] | [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/mimimiprod]Facebook[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/mimimigames/]Instagram[/url] |[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@mimimigames] TikTok[/url] to stay up to date.

☠️ And we have a [url=http://eepurl.com/gil0wb]Newsletter[/url] if you perhaps aren’t a fan of social media.

See you soon on the high seas, cursed pirates!

Elena

notes.title: New Developer Insight Trailer Out Now!
notes.content:
Ahoy cursed pirates!

Today, we're sharing special trailer with you: In our new [i]Developer Insight Trailer[/i] we give you a glimpse behind-the-scenes of [i]Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew[/i]

[previewyoutube=Nu8WlgBnJ8s;full][/previewyoutube]

Our Creative Director, Dominik Abé, is joined by our Head of Design, Moritz Wagner, to explain the thought process behind the development and the vision of [i]Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew[/i].

With the trailer we wanted to depict how the team brings [i]Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew[/i] to life in our small studio in Munich, Germany and give you a brief insight into what it's like to work here as an artist, designer or developer.

Moreover, we're finally ready to reveal a new member of your cursed pirate crew with the Developer Insight Trailer.

[h2]MEET TOYA, THE ASSASSIN COOK[/h2]
Next to the definition of "cool" you would probably find a cursed ninja pirate assassin cook in any lexicon of your choice.

Welcome Toya of Iga to the cursed pirate crew of the Red Marley! He is the cook of the ship and usually prepares tasty, soul infused meals for the crew.

But his amazing skills allow him to be a menace in combat, too. He can place as marker anywhere on the ground and use it to teleport back to that location at any given time immediately. This allows him to get out of dangerous situations really quickly but also for some advanced maneuvers and stylish kills: If an enemy stands on the marker when Toya is teleporting, the enemy will be attacked.

Moreover, Toya carries a whistle to lure enemies to his current location. When players use both his skills in combination, they can create lethal traps for enemies by luring them to the marker.

Check out his awesome design and abilities in our Developer Insight Trailer linked above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43536377/46c26dbffecd773fa9dcea1a624e3f237989981d.png[/img]

[h2]WISHLIST NOW![/h2]
[i]Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew[/i] is our new stealth strategy game.

Join a ghost ship with a living soul and assemble a cursed pirate crew. Embrace supernatural powers to defy the menacing army of the Inquisition, who stands between you and the mysterious treasure of the legendary Captain Mordechai.

The game is releasing on Steam in 2023.

Support us by wishlisting the game here on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545560

[h2]JOIN THE CREW![/h2]
Join our [url=http://discord.gg/mimimi]Discord[/url] if you can't wait for more news about [i]Shadow Gambit: The Cursed Crew[/i] or if you want to discuss the game with us and our growing Mimimi community.
